## About
Triple F Automotive restores classic cars and builds custom vehicles in a big shop on Golden Triangle Blvd, north of downtown Fort Worth. We totally dismantle your vehicle, hunt down factory replacement or era correct parts, and handle the fiberglass, metal, paint and upholstery in our own shop.
We work closely with you on a detailed list of what you want, match it up with a budget, and let you set your own deadline to cruise. If you'd rather buy ready to roll, our showroom carries American muscle, classics, street rods and select classic imports, and our classic parts department can help with the project in your garage.
Customers know Doug and Denise by name, and the shop holds a 4.7 rating from 75 Google reviews.

## Services
- Fiberglass repairs: Corvettes and kit cars, minor to major. We install front ends, replace panels and re-gelcoat fiberglass back to factory specs before body work begins.
- Blasting booth: Our blasting booth takes rust, paint and caulk off the structural parts of body panels, frames and suspension pieces after the panels are chemically stripped.
- Paint: Large down draft paint booths with bake capabilities let us paint the whole car at one time for a true color match.
- Fabrication: We cut out rusted panels, floors and quarters and replace or create what's needed with plasma, English wheel, planishing hammer, power bead roller and welding equipment.
- Upholstered interiors: Cloth, leather or something exotic, from a full interior built to your wildest ideas to simple repairs.
- Modern components: We can put a modern engine, transmission and disc brakes in your classic so it cruises with more power and ease.
- A/C installation: Air conditioning for your classic, so you can cruise on a Texas summer night.
- Showroom inventory: Ready to roll cars and trucks: American muscle, classics, street rods and select classic imports.
- Classic parts department: Parts on hand to help with your own restoration project.
- Concourse trim restoration: Our Concourse Trim team restores worn, scratched and dull trim. One reviewer said his molding came back with a mirror finish.

## FAQ
Q: Can I come look at the cars for sale?
A: Yes. Give us a call to make an appointment and come see the showroom on Golden Triangle Blvd in Fort Worth.

Q: Do you only do modern upgrades, or can you keep my car original?
A: Both. We can install modern components, and we also work on original drivetrains if you like it old school.
